**maze-rs** is a project in [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md). Its code is written mainly in [Rust](@/glossary/rust.md) (98.9 %), with [HTML](@/glossary/html.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created in November 2016; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 18 November 2016. It reads “More coments”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2016, kept for the record and dated as measured.

It runs as a live site on [GitHub Pages](@/glossary/github-pages.md): <https://korczis.github.io/maze-rs/>.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/maze-rs) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/maze-rs).

Related work in [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md): [algoglyph](@/work/algoglyph.md) (2026), [maze](@/work/maze.md) (2016), [graph-flow](@/work/graph-flow.md) (2017) and [rustas](@/work/rustas.md) (2018).
